MODULE_NOTES: Every bag in one window: by category, by bag or as one bag, with search and sorting.
TITLE: Inventory
ARRANGE_TIP: Moves the items into this order. Protected slots stay as they are.
BAG_SLOTS_TIP: Hover a bag to light its items.
PROTECTED: This slot is protected from sorting
BANK_SLOTS_TIP: A click on a bag picks it up, or puts the one on the cursor there.
BANK_COPY: As you left it at the banker
GUILD_COPY: This tab as you last saw it in the guild vault
BANK_UNSEEN: Visit a banker: the bank shows here from then on.
WHY_GREY: Junk: a grey item a merchant buys
LOOT_FAST_TIP: Where the game's auto loot takes a window, everything in it is taken at once, the game's loot window unseen; what can't be taken (a roll, full bags) leaves the window shown.
LOOT_EVERY_TIP: The game's own «Auto Loot» option, turned on for every character of the account.
LOOT_FULL_SOUND: A sound when the bags are full
LOOT_FULL_SOUND_TIP: Plays once a loot window, as something won't go into the bags.
LOOT_REEL_SOUND: The reel as a catch comes in
LOOT_REEL_SOUND_TIP: The game's own sound of a fish reeled in, as a catch's loot opens.
LOOT_TOASTS_ON_TIP: A line for each item, currency and the money looted, beside the screen's middle for a few seconds. Placing mode moves them.
SELL_JUNK_AUTO_TIP: As a merchant's window opens, the junk in the bags is sold, as «Sell junk» sells it: a dozen at most, so all can be bought back.
CHAT_NO_BAG_PLACE: no bag can be taken off for it.
CHAT_NO_BAG_ROOM: the bag it replaces holds more than the other bags have free.
REFUND_ASK: Return %s to the merchant for a refund?
REFUND_ASK_MONEY: Return %s to the merchant for a refund of %s?
CHAT_BAG_BUSY: put down what the cursor holds first.
CHAT_BAG_STUCK: the bag it replaces kept items the game wouldn't move; nothing was put on.
CHAT_LEARNED: %s is junk now: you often sell it.
SLOT_SIZE_TIP: How big a slot and its icon are, in the interface's pixels.
SLOT_GAP_TIP: The gap between two slots of a group, in steps of the interface spacing; 0 puts them side by side.
RULE_GREY_TIP: A grey item a merchant pays for is junk.
RULE_GREY_LEVEL_TIP: Grey weapons and armour are junk only above this item level.
RULE_LEARN_TIP: What you often sell yourself becomes junk.
RULE_CHAT_TIP: Sales, marks and what was learned, a line in the chat each.
CLICKS_TIP: The same in the bags, the bank and the guild bank. Use and the menu always keep a click.
ROW_LEAST_TIP: A group is at least this many slots wide, and the window narrows to one group this wide.
